dedupe_keys.name: fichier des donnees theoriques du reseau idelis au format gtfs

description: Fichier des données théoriques du réseau IDELIS au format GTFS is a dataset listed in IDELIS open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IDELIS. IDELIS met à disposition plusieurs jeux de données décrivant l’offre de transport sur l’Agglomération de Pau Béarn Pyrénées. Le jeu de données statiques au format GTFS expose l’offre théorique de transport. Coverage: Pau agglomeration (Idelis network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are gtfs, lignes, horaires, tracés, idelis. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-idelis-fr-portal.
